name: Fine Arts Museum
kicker: The yellow mansion on Phó Đức Chính
summary: Yellow mansion museum on Phó Đức Chính: walk the galleries 08:00–17:00 for the art collection. One visit is 60,000 đồng at 97 Phó Đức Chính, Phường Bến Thành. An adult ticket is 30,000 đồng at 97A Phó Đức Chính, Phường Nguyễn Thái Bình. Ask the desk which address and price to use.
getThere: About 1.8 km from Bạch Đằng, on Phó Đức Chính.
heroCaption: The yellow mansion and the iron gate, with the Mỹ Thuật sign

notice.title: Two prices are on the desk
notice.body: One visit is 60,000 đồng. An adult ticket is 30,000 đồng, a student 15,000 đồng, with free entry for a child under 6 and a visitor over 60. Ask which tariff the desk is using.

body: The museum is the yellow mansion on Phó Đức Chính. One address is 97 Phó Đức Chính, Phường Bến Thành, with 60,000 đồng a visit. The other is 97A Phó Đức Chính, Phường Nguyễn Thái Bình, Quận 1, with an adult at 30,000 đồng, a student or pupil at 15,000 đồng, and free entry for a child under 6 and a visitor over 60. Hours are 08:00–17:00, Monday through Sunday. From the Jade Emperor Pagoda the distance is about 3.9 km. From Bạch Đằng it is about 1.8 km.

A Sunday afternoon pairs the mansion with the War Remnants Museum. Leave bulky bags in the lockers. Phones may take commemorative pictures. Leave the flash off. Food and drink stay out of the galleries. The photograph is the facade and the gate. The second frame is the stair and the stained glass looking onto the yellow courtyard.

figures.caption: The stair and the stained glass, looking onto the yellow courtyard
figures.alt: Stained glass and staircase inside the Fine Arts Museum

gettingThere: The addresses are 97 Phó Đức Chính, Phường Bến Thành, and 97A Phó Đức Chính, Phường Nguyễn Thái Bình. From Bạch Đằng it is about 1.8 km. From the Jade Emperor Pagoda the distance is about 3.9 km.
admissionNote: 60,000 đồng a visit, at 97 Phó Đức Chính, Phường Bến Thành. Adult 30,000 đồng, pupil or student 15,000 đồng, free for a child under 6 and a visitor over 60, at 97A Phó Đức Chính, Phường Nguyễn Thái Bình. Show papers for a free or reduced ticket. From 1 October 2026 a city museum fee of 60,000 đồng also follows Resolution 29/2026/NQ-HĐND of 27 August 2026.
